name: Snowdonia in a day
description_md:
Snowdonia in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in GB. The trail covers a distance of 13.7 km and requires about 8.0 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

It follows a waymarked path through the landscape.
